name: Slice Filling with BFS Propagation
definition: Extends simple slice filling by propagating filled voxels to adjacent neighbors in the slice plane using a Breadth-First Search (BFS) if the neighbor is also empty in both the main voxel grid and the current buffer.
summary: Slice Filling with BFS Propagation extends simple slice filling by using Breadth-First Search to actively fill empty neighbors within the slice plane, differing by searching for and filling voids not solid in either the main grid or buffer.
